role.zh: 设备驱动、能力描述与 Agent 接入
role.en: Device drivers, capability descriptions and agent access

status.zh: Anthropic 研究预览；官网仍提供申请入口，公开公告表述为计划开源。
status.en: Anthropic research preview; the website retains an application entry point and the announcement describes open sourcing as forthcoming.

detail.zh: 公开材料说明统一驱动、读写原语、设备发现与物理说明标签，并提供 MCP、CLI、API 三种入口。精确兼容性应以正式发布的规范和实现为准。
detail.en: Public material describes common drivers, read/write primitives, discovery and physical-description tags, accessible through MCP, CLI and APIs. Exact compatibility requires the released specification and implementation.

standards.name: Agent–Instrument Protocol (AIP)

role.zh: 持久设备执行服务与实验说明
role.en: Persistent device execution service and experimental contracts

status.zh: 本项目讨论所用 AIP PRD v1.1，2026-10-18；用户提供的设计材料，未核实到对应公开实现。
status.en: AIP PRD v1.1, dated 2026-10-18, supplied for this project; a corresponding public implementation has not been verified.

detail.zh: 设计包含 Rust 常驻服务、类型化物理量、动作与长活动、类 profile、状态来源、资源冲突和事件恢复；gRPC 控制与 Arrow Flight 数据分开。PRD 未把 MCP 设为产品组成部分。
detail.en: The design includes a persistent Rust service, typed quantities, actions and long activities, class profiles, state provenance, resource conflicts and event recovery, separating gRPC control from Arrow Flight data. MCP is not a product component in the PRD.

standards.source_note: User-supplied AIP PRD v1.1 (2026-10-18); design reference, not a public software release.

role.zh: Agent 到仪器的说明提案

status.zh: arXiv:2606.03755 的 LAP v0.1 设计；论文明确尚非规范性标准或实现报告。
status.en: LAP v0.1 design in arXiv:2606.03755; the paper explicitly distinguishes it from a normative standard or implementation report.

detail.zh: InstrumentCard、资源预留、任务生命周期和测量结果对象值得比较；单位、校准与不确定度属于说明的实验含义。
detail.en: InstrumentCard, reservations, task lifecycle and measurement-result objects offer useful comparisons, especially units, calibration and uncertainty.

role.zh: Agent 与工具、资源之间的通用交互
role.en: General interaction between agents, tools and resources

status.zh: 公开协议、SDK 与扩展生态。
status.en: Public protocol, SDKs and extension ecosystem.

detail.zh: JSON Schema 可携带单位和设备约束；Tasks 扩展提供可持久查询的任务句柄。真正缺少的往往是跨设备一致的物理语义与执行实现，而非 JSON 无法表达这些字段。
detail.en: JSON Schema can carry units and device constraints; the Tasks extension provides durable task handles. The remaining work is shared physical semantics and execution implementations, not an inability to represent those fields in JSON.

role.zh: 实验室服务、Feature、Command 与 Property
role.en: Laboratory services, features, commands and properties

status.zh: 已有标准与多语言实现；旧 sila_python 文档已标为不维护并指向后继库。
status.en: An established standard with implementations in several languages; the older sila_python documentation marks that implementation unmaintained and points to successors.

detail.zh: 可观测命令、执行状态和中间结果适合映射为 Agent 长任务。LabMCP 的 SiLA 2 桥可作为适配代码参考，当前仍是模拟验证。
detail.en: Observable commands, execution states and intermediate responses map naturally to agent jobs. LabMCP’s SiLA 2 bridge is an adapter-code reference, currently simulation-verified.

role.zh: 设备信息模型、功能单元与程序管理
role.en: Device information models, functional units and program management

status.en: OPC UA Companion Specification, LADS Part 1.

detail.zh: 功能单元可暴露状态机；Program Manager 管理程序模板、执行与结果。通用 OPC UA-MCP 连接器不会自动理解所有 LADS 业务语义。
detail.en: Functional units can expose state machines; a Program Manager manages templates, execution and results. A generic OPC UA-MCP connector does not automatically interpret all LADS semantics.

status.zh: Thing Description 1.1 推荐标准；2.0 另有草案轨道。
status.en: Thing Description 1.1 Recommendation, with a separate 2.0 draft track.

detail.zh: Properties、Actions、Events 以及交互表单，将能力语义与具体协议绑定分开。可借鉴到仪器描述，无需替换底层设备总线。
detail.en: Properties, Actions, Events and interaction forms separate capability semantics from protocol bindings. Useful for instrument descriptions without replacing device buses.

role.zh: 科学设施设备与控制通道

status.zh: 保留已有控制系统，通过 Agent 适配层接入。
status.en: Retain the control system and connect an agent adapter.

detail.zh: Osprey 提供三者连接器；TANGO MCP 和 EPICS MCP 提供更直接的桥。需要保留通道名、单位、时间与质量信息。
detail.en: Osprey supplies connectors for all three; TANGO MCP and EPICS MCP offer more direct bridges. Preserve channel identity, units, timestamps and quality.

role.zh: 参数、Station、仪器驱动与测量数据
role.en: Parameters, stations, instrument drivers and measurement data

status.zh: Python 测量生态，可由 instrMCP 直接复用。
status.en: Python measurement ecosystem directly reused by instrMCP.

detail.zh: 重用参数验证、单位、快照和数据集；区分 cached 值与 fresh 查询。
detail.en: Reuse parameter validation, units, snapshots and datasets; distinguish cached values from fresh queries.

role.zh: 设备抽象、实验计划与执行
role.en: Device abstractions, experiment plans and execution

status.zh: 已有束线使用路径；VISION 在其上提供自然语言入口。
status.en: An established beamline execution route, with VISION providing a natural-language entry point.

detail.zh: Agent 可以选择和参数化实验计划，由 RunEngine 执行；不必逐个低层调用穿过模型推理。
detail.en: Agents can select and parameterize plans for a RunEngine to execute instead of routing each low-level call through model reasoning.

role.zh: 液体处理的设备、资源和执行接口
role.en: Device, resource and execution interfaces for liquid handling

status.zh: 多个独立 MCP 服务复用的底层。
status.en: Underlying interfaces reused by several independent MCP servers.

detail.zh: PyLabRobot backend、机器人 HTTP run 与上层 Agent 工具是不同层；模拟器通过不代表真实甲板、液体与吸头行为相同。
detail.en: PyLabRobot backends, robot HTTP runs and agent tools are distinct layers. Simulator success does not establish equivalent deck, liquid and tip behavior.

role.zh: 机器人主题、服务、动作与传感器
role.en: Robot topics, services, actions and sensors

status.zh: ROS MCP 与 ROSA 的既有机器人接入基础。
status.en: Existing robot integration foundation for ROS MCP and ROSA.

detail.zh: 机器人导航、规划和实时控制留在机器人软件栈；Agent 发目标、调用动作并检查反馈。
detail.en: Navigation, planning and real-time control remain in the robot stack; agents submit goals, call actions and inspect feedback.

role.zh: 已有台式仪器的可编程入口
role.en: Programmable access to existing bench instruments

status.zh: MCP 桥接最密集的一类接入路径。
status.en: A prominent integration route among instrument MCP bridges.

detail.zh: VISA 是访问抽象，SCPI 是指令体系；接口一致不保证不同型号的触发、波形编码、缓冲与错误行为一致。
detail.en: VISA is an access abstraction; SCPI is a command system. Similar interfaces do not guarantee identical triggering, waveform encoding, buffering or error behavior across models.

role.zh: 显微镜、相机与光机部件

status.zh: Agent 复用已有显微与相机设备适配。
status.en: Agent integration reuses existing microscopy and camera adapters.

detail.zh: 图像需要与曝光、位置、通道、像素尺寸和校准版本关联；一次返回图片不等于完整测量记录。
detail.en: Images should be linked to exposure, position, channel, pixel size and calibration revision; an image response alone is not a complete measurement record.

reason.zh: Agent 评测与环境运行框架，不是物理仪器协议。
reason.en: An agent evaluation and environment framework, not a physical-instrument protocol.

reason.zh: 虚拟量子实验基准；可供测试 Agent，不能作为实机驱动证据。
reason.en: A virtual quantum-experiment benchmark; useful for agent evaluation, not evidence of hardware drivers.

reason.zh: 公开 MCP 主要检索规范、节点定义和术语；应归入知识接口。
reason.en: Its public MCP searches specifications, node definitions and terminology: a knowledge interface.

reason.zh: 同缩写 AIP，研究 Agent 间交互；不是这里的 Agent–Instrument Protocol。
reason.en: Another AIP acronym, addressing interaction among agents rather than the Agent–Instrument Protocol discussed here.

reason.zh: 同缩写 AIP，研究身份与授权；不是仪器说明。
reason.en: Another AIP acronym, addressing identity and authorization rather than instrument contracts.

reason.zh: WebMCP 虚拟化学实验，与 K-Dense 的仪器适配集合不同。
reason.en: A virtual chemistry lab using WebMCP, distinct from K-Dense’s instrument adapter collection.

reason.zh: 分析、规划与模拟系统；本次未核实可独立复用的完整实机接口链，保留为研究线索。
reason.en: Analysis, planning and simulation system; a complete reusable physical-device path was not verified in this review, so retained as a research lead.

reason.zh: 当前仓库是文献、工作区与计算任务助手，不能因同名资料归为仪器 GUI Agent。
reason.en: The current repository is a literature, workspace and compute-task assistant, not evidence for a similarly named instrument GUI agent.

reason.zh: 技能集合与实验工作层；与 labclaw/device-use 分属不同工程，未据名称合并。
reason.en: A skills collection and laboratory operating layer, distinct from labclaw/device-use; names alone do not establish a shared implementation.

reason.zh: caidish/instrMCP 的 fork；保留上游主记录，避免重复计数。
reason.en: A fork of caidish/instrMCP; the upstream entry is retained to avoid duplicate counting.

reason.zh: 原始海报说明操作的是 TEM / STM 图像模拟后端，并提供 GitLab 地址；不作为真实显微镜控制案例。
reason.en: The original poster describes TEM/STM image-simulation backends and links a GitLab repository; it is not counted as physical microscope control.

reason.zh: MIT 研究代码包含光学数字孪生、算子与残差接口、固定实验记录及重放验证；README 明确不含在线仪器控制或硬件专用 API。可借鉴实验反馈表示，不计为公开实机驱动。
reason.en: The MIT research release provides optical twins, operator/residual interfaces, frozen records and replay validation. Its README explicitly excludes live instrument control and hardware-specific APIs; it informs feedback design, rather than supplying a public hardware driver.

method.zh: 按项目、论文、官方文档、许可证及关键实现路径核查。实验状态引用作者或维护者的公开记录，本次未操作这些实机。组件与 fork 不重复计为独立工程。
method.en: Reviewed repositories, papers, official documentation, licenses and selected implementation paths. Experiment status reflects author or maintainer records; this review did not operate those instruments. Components and forks are not counted as independent projects.
